# Alejandro Perez-canto

> Alejandro Perez-canto (also written Perez-canto, Perezcanto or Alejandro Pérez Canto) is a full-stack developer and UI/UX designer. He builds fast, accessible, multilingual and SEO-optimized websites and web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, and works remotely with clients worldwide in Spanish and English. Website: https://www.perez-canto.com

## Who he is

- Name: Alejandro Perez-canto
- Role: Full-Stack Developer and UI/UX designer (Spanish: Desarrollador Full-Stack)
- Experience: more than 5 years building digital products for startups, agencies and established companies
- Education: studying Systems Engineering at Universidad Santiago Mariño (2022 to present); professional certifications from Udemy, Platzi and Skillshare
- Languages: Spanish and English
- Works: remotely, with clients anywhere in the world; meetings by video call
- Contact: alejandroperezcanto@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/perezcanto
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/alejandro-perez-canto-8b8432193

## Skills and stack

- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Laravel, PHP
- Databases: MongoDB, MySQL
- Design: UI/UX design, Figma, Adobe XD
- Performance: Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, Webpack, bundling
- Deployment: Vercel, cPanel, Git

## Services

- Responsive web design
- UI/UX design
- Performance optimization
- Web accessibility (WCAG)
- SEO and marketing
- E-commerce solutions
- Multilingual websites and internationalization (i18n)
- Maintenance and support
- Database management, cloud and API integrations

## How he works

1. Discovery: understand the business, audience and goals; agree on scope and priorities.
2. Design: define structure, content and visual style; the client reviews real screens first.
3. Development: build with Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, with performance, accessibility and SEO from day one.
4. Launch and support: ship, measure, refine, then ongoing maintenance and new features.
